newsitem.title: USA: BW/IP sees Q3 earnings at $0.27/shr.
newsitem.headline: BW/IP sees Q3 earnings at $0.27/shr.

text.p: BW/IP Inc said on Monday it expects third quarter earnings of around $0.27 a share, within analysts' estimates of $0.25 to $0.32 and above the year-earlier $0.26.
BW/IP, which reports third quarter results October 23, also said full-year earnings remain in line with estimates.

"Some of the shift in shipment timing from the third quarter to the fourth that we discussed at the end of the second quarter has indeed occurred. This was not unusual in our business, and we believe the company's earnings will remain on track for the full year, in line with analysts' current earnings estimates," said chief executive Bernard Rethore.
